@m [참고] Spells being cast are interrupted the moment Invoke finishes, so do not overlap an empowered Dream Breath cast with that moment; if needed, use Tip the Scales to cast it instantly at max rank

Ula'tek: [해제] Cleanse Blightscale Viper's Acidic Burst poison DoT with Naturalize; if it is on cooldown, Cauterizing Flame can also remove it

note: There are no spec-specific sources per raid boss, so these are general principles written by matching spell tooltips to boss mechanics.

notes: Naturalize removes Magic and Poison; Cauterizing Flame removes Poison
Spells from only one hero tree such as Consume Flame and Temporal Burst are excluded; Rewind has no extra healing increase in raids

Season 1: The dispel lines pair the digest dispel list (Magic·Poison·Curse) with the Naturalize and Cauterizing Flame tooltips. Rending Tear and Impale bleeds are not in the dispel list, so no Cauterizing Flame lines were written for them.
Season 1: Rescue was used only where the digest says to carry the Blistercreep target to the wall. Hero talent-only spells (Chrono Flame, etc.) were not used.
